design_philosophy.emotion: Technical precision, undeniable authority, and playful modern disruption.
design_philosophy.archetype_mix: Swiss High-Contrast (structural rigor) + Electric Neon/Playful (accent colors & state changes)
design_philosophy.description: A developer-focused SaaS dashboard bridging dense cryptographic data with modern, clean UI. It uses a high-contrast dark theme, monospace typography for technical data, and terminal-inspired components mixed with vibrant, playful accents to avoid feeling overly sterile or intimidating.

headings.description: Clean, geometric, and modern corporate SaaS look. No Inter or generic sans.

body_and_data.description: Tech/Developer focused. Used for JSON, hashes, logs, and primary data displays.

hierarchy_limits.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl (fluid clamp, never above text-6xl)

general.spacing_scale: Use generous padding: p-6 or p-8 inside cards. Gap-6 to gap-8 for structural layout.
general.container: Max-w-7xl mx-auto, never strictly center-align text (left-align for readability).

bento_grid.rules: Every pixel utilized. h-full on children. No jagged bottoms.

wizard_layout.structure: A left-hand vertical step indicator (cols-3) paired with a massive right-hand active panel (cols-9), OR a top horizontal stepper. Favor vertical for developer tools to allow scrolling complex data.

cards.style: The 'Technical' Look. 1px solid border (border-white/10), flat background (#111318), no heavy shadows. Sharp or max 8px border-radius (rounded-md).

terminal_blocks.style: Retro-Futurism. Deep black background (#050505), monospace fonts, bright syntax highlighting (neon cyan/pink/green), subtle inner shadow or 1px border. Perfect for 'Simulated Blockchain Anchor Logs' and 'Raw JSON'.

glassmorphism.usage: Sticky headers, floating notifications, or context menus.

shadcn_overrides.buttons: Sharp corners or slight radius (rounded-md). Always explicitly set hover text color (e.g., hover:bg-blue-600 hover:text-white).
shadcn_overrides.cards: Remove default heavy box-shadows. Rely on borders.

motion.rules: Micro-interactions on hover. Staggered entrance for list items. Do NOT use universal 'transition: all'. Use specific transitions (transform 0.2s ease, opacity 0.2s ease).
motion.merkle_visualization: Animate the hashing process (S0 -> H0 -> S1 -> H1) with staggered fading paths/arrows and glowing borders on the active state.

key_features_implementation.wizard: State-driven step-by-step UI. 1. Input Transaction -> 2. CLOUUD Encoder -> 3. Reasoning Proof -> 4. Blockchain Anchor -> 5. Verification.
key_features_implementation.live_ai_trace: A terminal-like feed component. Use a typing effect or staggered entry to show reasoning states (verify_user, verify_balance) appearing sequentially.
key_features_implementation.hash_merkle_tree: Flex/Grid based diagram using Framer Motion to draw lines/arrows between states (S0...S4) and their corresponding Hashes (H0...H4), culminating in the final root proof.
key_features_implementation.compact_proof_blob: Display as a self-describing JSON block inside a visually distinct card, utilizing syntax highlighting.
key_features_implementation.blockchain_logs: Terminal style window displaying the simulated Ethereum tx (from, data: CLOUUD_ROOT). Use typewriter effect or raw log appending style.

icons.style: Duotone or Regular weight. Consistent sizing.

images.usage: Minimal. Use abstract textures only if necessary for empty states or hero headers.

urls.description: Subtle abstract metal/honeycomb texture. Use with high opacity overlay (e.g., bg-black/90) just to add noise/texture to a header or empty state.

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure text meets APCA/WCAG AA standards. Interactive elements must have 3:1 contrast.
accessibility_and_testing.focus: High contrast focus rings required on all inputs and buttons.
accessibility_and_testing.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute (kebab-case, role-based). Example: data-testid='generate-proof-button'.

instructions_to_main_agent: Prioritize JetBrains Mono for all cryptographic data, hashes, JSON payloads, and logs to emphasize the developer tool aesthetic.
Implement a robust Wizard state machine to navigate the 5 distinct phases of the Proof-of-Reasoning flow.
The UI must feel like a high-end corporate SaaS product combined with a hacker terminal. Balance the clean cards with the deep black, glowing-text terminal sections.
Use Framer Motion to animate the 'CLOUUD Encoder' and 'Hash/Merkle' generation steps so it feels 'live' and computational.
Do not use default Shadcn heavy drop-shadows on cards; use the 'Technical Grid' approach with 1px borders.
Ensure the 'Compact Proof Blob' clearly highlights the structural breakdown (transaction_id, algorithm, merkle_root, compression_ratio) as requested in the specs.

Incorporate the required 'Playful/Colorful' elements by assigning vibrant, distinct colors to different tag states (e.g., Pink for 'State Transition', Yellow for 'Hash Generation', Cyan for 'Merkle Root').
Never center-align large blocks of text or terminal code.

universal_guidelines.avoid_ai_slop: Don't make generic centered layouts or simplistic gradients. Create depth through layered design (z-index) and subtle borders.
universal_guidelines.motion_required: Every interaction needs micro-animations (hover states, transitions).
universal_guidelines.no_emoji_icons: NEVER use AI assistant emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡 for icons. Use Phosphor Icons.
